_meta.source: action names from NayaFlow's icon set; chords looked up per platform and then validated through openflow_backend.device.remap.encode_keypress -- any chord that would not encode was dropped, not shipped

fields.action: NayaFlow's action name, also the icon file name
fields.win/mac/linux: {chord, bytes} -- absent when there is no standard binding
fields.context: os | browser | text | vscode | terminal | file-manager | media | keyboard-hardware | null
fields.appSpecific: true when the binding only holds inside one application
fields.confidence: high | medium | low, as reported by the look-up
